findings.title: S-2 still open: authoritative commands bypass cookie variant validation
findings.body: `onCommand` casts an unknown serialized payload directly to `Command`. The later command validator checks only regex compatibility, while add/update/undo-restore/import/backup-restore paths insert their Profile or Modification payloads without calling `isModification` or validating the resulting state. A Set-Cookie containing both `raw` and structured fields can therefore be persisted despite the new exclusive union and storage/import parser checks. Compilation then prefers the stale raw line; on the next v3 load, state validation fails and returns `reset`, exposing all profiles to replacement by a subsequent write. The invariant is therefore not enforced at the authoritative write boundary every remaining slice will use.
findings.recommendation: Runtime-decode and validate every Profile/Modification-bearing command, or validate the complete next StoredState before persistence. Add rejection/no-write tests for add, update, undo restore, direct import, and backup restore commands carrying contradictory Set-Cookie variants.
